project.name: toy-node
project.summary: A toy web app that keeps a shared list of snacks for a weekly meetup.

brief.verbatim: I want a list where everyone says what snack they bring, so we stop getting five bags of crisps.

release.name: First snacks
release.notin: reminders by email, later on the roadmap

service.name: Toy Host
service.exit: a static export on any free host

park.trigger: nobody opens it for a month

fire.stop: the hosted app and the database
fire.keep: the repo and the plans folder

rhythm: One evening a week, about two hours.

v01.steps:
| Step | Who builds | Files | Check | Budget |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. The list page | builder | src/ | scripts/check.sh | 5M |

first.commit: The skeleton: CLAUDE.md, README, kit.json, checks and CI. Subject: "Start toy-node".

adr.context: A meetup needs one place to say who brings what.
adr.decision: A small web app on free tiers.
adr.where: Toy Host for the app, Toy Database for the rows.
adr.consequences: Free until the triggers in V0.1.md; parked when they fire.
